# SnapOrder Kiosk

> Car-lane screen for one SnapOrder branch. Staff sign in with a kiosk account. The person in the car does not sign in.

## Indexing

These pages are indexable. robots.txt allows `/`. Do not add `noindex`. `/api/` is not a page, so it stays out of the index.

- /sign-in — public staff login
- /kiosk — lane screen. A visitor without a session is redirected to /sign-in. The lane URL itself stays allowed.
- /kiosk/dual-screen — outdoor concept. Same account language and scheme.

## Screens

- /sign-in — staff login for the sign-in chrome only.
- /kiosk — lane. Chrome is English. Light or dark comes from the account. Item names show English and Arabic. There is no language switch.

## Demo

Password for every account: demo-lane

- lane.en@demo — English, left to right, light, Snap Coffee lane
- lane.stage@demo — English, left to right, dark, Snap Coffee lane
- lane.half@demo — English, left to right, light, Half Million lane
- lane.half.dark@demo — English, left to right, dark, Half Million lane

A Start control stands in for the lane sensor and plays scripted agent lines. On Vercel, leave KIOSK_API_URL unset. The built-in demo lane serves sign-in, bootstrap, presence, and events.

## Out of scope

Ordering, payment, ElevenLabs audio, and the hardware sensor are not in this demo.
